description: This file defines the TextElement class, which is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's RichText component. It implements the ITextElement interface and handles simple text elements, including retrieving and setting text, returning null for font information, and generating a hash code.

classes.name: TextElement
classes.description: Represents a text element within the RichText component, providing methods to manipulate text data and generate hash codes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of TextElement with optional text content.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content and returns the current instance for chaining.

methods.name: getFont
methods.description: Returns null as this class does not associate with font information.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates an md5 hash based on the text content and class name.
